intro: Welcome back to Quiz Rush! Today it's Guess the Country. Forty famous places, four levels, ten seconds each. Ready? Let's travel!
q: First stop! Which country is home to this famous clock tower?
Easy one, don't tip over. Where would you find this leaning tower?
Arms wide open! This giant statue overlooks which country's famous city?
Snow on top, perfect cone. In which country is this volcano?
Still being built after more than a century! Which country is home to this basilica?
Look way up! The world's tallest building is in which country?
History lovers, this one's for you. Where is this famous gate?
Those domes look like candy! Which country are they in?
Back to ancient times. Which country built this temple?
Last easy question! Four presidents carved in stone. Which country?
Level up! Welcome to the Medium round. Which country is home to this fairy-tale castle?
Jungle pyramid alert! In which country is it?
White walls, blue domes, sunsets. Where is this?
Empires came and went around this building. Which country is it in?
Flat as a table. This mountain is in which country?
Covered in real gold leaf! Where is this temple?
Science meets architecture. Which country built this giant atom?
A ship on top of three towers! Which country?
Mysterious faces staring at you. Which country do they belong to?
Final Medium question! Where is this giant red rock?
You made it to the Hard round! Which country is home to this bay of limestone islands?
Waterfalls everywhere you look. Which country is this?
Twin towers glowing at night. Which country?
A church that looks like a rocket! Which country?
Thousands of temples on one plain. Which country?
Hot-air balloons and fairy chimneys. Where would you see these?
Statues line this old stone bridge. Which country?
Ice as far as the eye can see. In which country is this glacier?
A tiny island with a church in the middle of a lake. Where is it?
Last Hard question! Which country is home to this dramatic fiord?
This is it, the Genius round! Razor-sharp stone forests. Which country?
The sky meets the ground here. Which country is home to this salt flat?
An ancient fortress on a giant rock. Where is it?
Monks living on top of rock pillars! Which country?
Tiles, arches and turquoise domes. Which country?
Hold on tight! Which country is home to this cliffside monastery?
They look good enough to eat! Where are these hills?
Spooky question! This castle is linked to Dracula. Which country?
Mountains all around the water. Where is this bay?
Final question! This church was carved into solid rock. Which country?
a: The United Kingdom! The great bell inside is nicknamed Big Ben.
Italy, of course. It started leaning soon after construction began in 1173.
Brazil! Christ the Redeemer has watched over Rio since 1931.
Japan! Mount Fuji is three thousand seven hundred and seventy-six metres high.
Spain! The Sagrada Familia in Barcelona has been under construction since 1882.
The United Arab Emirates. The Burj Khalifa in Dubai is eight hundred and twenty-eight metres tall.
Germany! The Brandenburg Gate in Berlin was completed in 1791.
Russia! That's Saint Basil's Cathedral on Red Square in Moscow.
Greece. The Parthenon in Athens was finished in 438 BC.
The United States! Each face on Mount Rushmore is about eighteen metres tall.
Germany! Neuschwanstein was built for King Ludwig the Second of Bavaria.
Mexico! Chichen Itza was a great Maya city.
Greece! This is Oia, on the island of Santorini.
Turkey. Hagia Sophia in Istanbul was completed in 537.
South Africa! Table Mountain towers over Cape Town.
Japan! Kinkaku-ji, the Golden Pavilion, is in Kyoto.
Belgium! The Atomium in Brussels was built for the 1958 World's Fair.
Singapore! Marina Bay Sands opened in 2010.
Chile! The Moai of Easter Island were carved by the Rapa Nui people.
Australia! Uluru is sacred to the Anangu people.
Vietnam! Ha Long Bay has about sixteen hundred islands and islets.
Croatia! Plitvice has sixteen lakes linked by waterfalls.
Malaysia! The Petronas Towers were the world's tallest buildings from 1998 to 2004.
Iceland! Hallgrimskirkja is the country's largest church.
Myanmar! Bagan still has more than two thousand temples and pagodas.
Turkey! Welcome to Cappadocia.
The Czech Republic! Work on Charles Bridge in Prague began in 1357.
Argentina! Perito Moreno is in Patagonia.
Slovenia! This is the famous Lake Bled.
New Zealand! Milford Sound is in Fiordland National Park.
Madagascar! Tsingy de Bemaraha is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Bolivia! Salar de Uyuni is the largest salt flat on Earth.
Sri Lanka! Sigiriya was built in the fifth century.
Greece! These are the monasteries of Meteora.
Uzbekistan! The Registan is the heart of Samarkand.
Bhutan! Tiger's Nest sits about nine hundred metres above the valley.
The Philippines! There are more than twelve hundred Chocolate Hills on Bohol.
Romania! Bran Castle is often linked to the Dracula legend.
Montenegro! The old town of Kotor is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Ethiopia! The rock churches of Lalibela are around eight hundred years old.
outro: And that's the end of our trip around the world! How many countries did you get? Tell us your score in the comments, and subscribe for the next Quiz Rush!
